study.question: After the semantic partition preserved click AUC with less dense capacity, can removing duplicate direct context connectivity across its two buy branches preserve incumbent AUC and reduce measured prediction cost? Does its value depend on retaining semantic target/history grouping rather than merely reducing parameters?
study.hypothesis: Observation: g2-r0053-joint_partition_semantic has click AUC0.667236221253505, dense192883, train314.9857s, inference24.9696s and p50/p95=14.9970/15.0871ms. Its same-round dense reference is0.6671669182126774 with204531 dense parameters and15.3394/15.5234ms; width87 has0.6669749347872882 with192881, and mixed has0.6668867685163927 with192883. This is single-seed evidence of useful allocation, not established superiority or semantic mechanism. Earlier prefix/suffix/spread width96 and two rank73 factors also lost AUC; residual6 and second48 branches show other capacity losses, so parameter reduction alone is not supported. Provisional mechanism: full context need not enter every first-affine neuron if every context field is represented by complementary coordinate halves, the full-input buy residual remains, and the dense second layer can reunite the112 channels. The semantic target/history partition may preserve useful specialization under this reduction. This is an additional bounded connectivity test, not a new unified-modeling originality claim. Public model sources and accepted receipts agree on protocol/input identities; raw parquet, loader execution and torch are not present here, so raw digest, masking and numerical readiness are inherited host prerequisites rather than independently reverified facts.

study.proposed_difference: Introduce architecture-only owner_context_partition=shared|split. Shared is an exact original constructor column selection; split assigns the first8 coordinates of each16-dimensional context field to rows0..55 and the complementary8 to rows56..111. In semantic mode this yields56x192 and56x208 packed weights instead of56x288 and56x304. Retain all112 biases/Dice channels,64-channel dense second layer, readout, and full-input residual. Actual weights are sliced/cloned only after all parent initialization; discarded weights are physically absent. Mixed repeats this reduction with the existing target/history grouping replacement. Dense64/64 is a near parameter match (32 extra parameters), using the existing full template and prefix slicing. There are no forward-method, loss, data, scoring or recipe edits.
predictions: Freeze utility before screening: absolute click-AUC loss at most0.0001 against contemporaneous semantic shared reference, plus click AUC>=0.667136221253505 (incumbent0.667236221253505 minus0.0001). Retain the original topic entry preservation floor0.666653547526167 separately; the stronger incumbent gate must also pass and does not replace prior results. A new best click score alone does not establish a mechanism.

Analytic embedding parameters stay31793216. Reference dense/total=192883/31986099; split and mixed dense/total=182131/31975347; dense64 dense/total=182163/31975379. Split removes10752 additional weights (5.57% of incumbent dense,0.0336% of total); first-buy-affine multiply-accumulates fall33152->22400 per example. These are symbolic predictions requiring host count confirmation, not whole-model measured compute reductions.

Efficiency utility additionally requires lower counted parameters and at least1% lower matched model-only p50 latency versus contemporaneous reference; report p95, inference wall/throughput, training wall, allocated GPU time, processed examples and peak memory even if they worsen. Require p95 no more than1% worse and training wall no more than5% worse for an operational recommendation. Confirm any screening cost advantage in host-authorized repeated measurements before calling it reproducible; do not select on noisy wall-time alone.

Semantic split passing the AUC/cost gates while matched mixed split and/or dense64 fail would support this allocation locally. A semantic-minus-mixed AUC difference>=0.0001 with both using exactly182131 dense parameters is the predeclared grouping contrast; compare with the earlier shared-context difference0.0003494527361123 descriptively, with a fresh mixed-shared arm reserved before any strong interaction claim.

Report every task AUC/Logloss and separate auxiliary mean; the parent buy AUC0.7212394189392151 and cart/fav near0.679 are much below DIN auxiliary scores. Preserving click does not imply preserving all feedback quality. History-length slices use inherited bins with samples/positives/negatives and remain exploratory; other slices or user-cluster intervals are reported only if supplied by authorized host feedback.
falsifiers: A bridge failure to reproduce parent AUC/parameter count or any forward/backward, masking, ownership, partial-batch, BF16 or buffer check failure blocks scientific interpretation; preserve the charged failure receipt and diagnose before retrying.

Either AUC preservation gate failing rejects utility of this implementation. Failure to achieve the frozen measured latency improvement, even with fewer parameters/MACs, rejects prediction-cost utility.

If mixed split matches or beats semantic split, the semantic-grouping explanation is unsupported at this reduced connectivity. If dense64 matches semantic split in AUC and measured cost, specialized sparse allocation has no demonstrated advantage over simple width reduction.

Consistent AUC loss for split with a reproduced reference limits the context-duplication redundancy hypothesis for this fixed allocation. It neither proves every direct context edge is necessary nor refutes all structured allocation mechanisms.
Seed-sensitive reversal or nonreproducible latency savings defeats a repeated-support claim. No held-out outcomes may drive follow-up selection.
alternative_explanations: All outcomes at the current host seed are preliminary; adaptive reuse of validation and inherited random row/coordinate assignment can favor this mask. Repeating a deterministic seed is not independent support.

Masks change buy activation scale, Dice running statistics and context gradients. Those are mediators of this connectivity change, not isolated explanations of a general capacity law. Dense clipping can couple task updates.

The full-context residual and dense second layer provide alternative information paths; this does not test removal of context information from the whole model. Packed GEMMs, gathers and runtime noise can dominate small operation savings.
The tiny0.000069303 parent-over-dense AUC difference may be validation selection noise. The old semantic/mixed contrast is one inherited-coordinate allocation, not an invariant property of semantics.

Different retained coefficient norms and Dice calibration rather than grouping itself may explain outcomes. The present study deliberately retains parent coefficients to preserve common initialization, so it does not isolate native fan-in initialization.

Auxiliary task quality, context gradient regularization and shared dense gradient clipping can mediate click performance even when click forward code is identical; training diagnostics are not currently supplied (receipts say not_requested).
